values.note: 34 sites on the primary dune of the beach and 34 on the riverside. The park gives a 47-ft maximum for the beach sites; Reserve Florida lists the Riverside RV sites at 53 to 90 ft (two of them pull-through) and four tent-only sites there.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/gamble-rogers-memorial-state-recreation-area-flagler-beach/experiences-amenities-0 ('The campground has 34 sites located on the primary dune of the beach and 34 sites located on the riverside'; 'The maximum RV length is 47 feet on the beach sites.') + Reserve Florida facility 57 (VehicleLength 53-90 on its 25 RV units, PullInTypeName 'Pull Through' on 2), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/gamble-rogers-memorial-state-recreation-area-flagler-beach/experiences-amenities-0 ('All sites feature water, electricity') + Reserve Florida facilities 56/57 (Electric Hookup 50 and Water Hookup on every RV unit, 'Electricity Hookup: 20,30,& 50' on beach sites; Sewer Hookup on Riverside sites 036, 061, 066), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/gamble-rogers-memorial-state-recreation-area-flagler-beach/experiences-amenities-0 ('A communal dump station is free to park campers'; 'Both campgrounds have a full-service bathhouse with accessible shower and restroom facilities'; 'Laundry facilities are available in the campgrounds for registered campers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations up to 11 months ahead (Florida residents; Reserve Florida opened 10 months ahead to an anonymous search on 2026-10-21), online or at 800-326-3521.

Visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521') + Reserve Florida facilities 56/57 restrictions (MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 14, FutureBookingEnds 2027-08-21), read 2026-10-21

note: About half the sites in the beachside loop are oceanfront, but dunes and vegetation may block the view. --AWH  BEACHSIDE CLOSED: 'Effective June 23, 2026: The beachside campground, day use parking lot and restroom ... are currently closed for an improvement project' (park page, read 2026-10-21; no reopening date given; Reserve Florida showed no beachside site free in December 2026). The Riverside campground is open. RVers should use I-95 exit 284 or 268, not 278 (tight turns, low tree clearance). --Claude
summary: Park page + Reserve Florida: 68 sites (34 beach, 34 riverside), water + 50-amp at every site and sewer at 3 Riverside sites, 2 Riverside pull-throughs, beach sites to 47 ft and Riverside to 90 ft; showers, free dump station, laundry; inherited reservable/operator/11-month window confirmed, 14-night max. Fees ($28 + $7) unchanged, matched by Reserve Florida's $28 rate today. Note: added the beachside campground's closure (since 2026-06-23, no reopening date) and the park's I-95 exit advice. Not stated: season.
flags: Partial closure: the beachside campground (half the sites, and the reason for the coastal dunes call) has been closed since 2026-06-23 for an improvement project with no reopening date; recorded in the note, not in status, since the Riverside campground operates.
Phone missing: the park's number is 386-517-2086 (https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/gamble-rogers-memorial-state-recreation-area-flagler-beach).
Name: the agency and Reserve Florida publish 'Gamble Rogers Memorial State Recreation Area at Flagler Beach'; the entry is just 'Gamble Rogers' (AWH's own entry, so left alone).
